comment: Whether rate limiting is applied to order placement requests.
modal: When Yes, the number of order-placement requests is capped per customer and per guest to protect the store from bursts of checkout traffic. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Maximum order-placement requests allowed per authenticated customer in the period.
modal: The cap on how many order-placement requests a single signed-in customer may make within the configured reset period. Applies only when rate limiting is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Maximum order-placement requests allowed per guest in the period.
modal: The cap on how many order-placement requests a single guest may make within the configured reset period. Applies only when rate limiting is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The length of the time window after which the request counter resets.
modal: Selects the time period over which order-placement requests are counted before the per-customer and per-guest limits reset. Applies only when rate limiting is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.
